Package com.example.wackah_mole

Class MoleBrain

java.lang.Object
com.example.wackah_mole.MoleBrain
public class MoleBrain extends Object
The MoleBrain class represents the Mole's ability to learn MoleBrain is implemented in a "Reinforcement Learning" approach Where the state is the grid of holes, and which position the mole is currently in A reward is given with the mole successfully hides from the player, or hits the player back A penalty is given when the mole is hit
Author:
John Brttain

    • updateQtable

      public void updateQtable(GameState state, MoleBrain.Action action, Double reward, GameState nextState)
      Performs a Q-learning update on the Q-table for a given state-action pair.

      This method adjusts the Q-value for the provided (state, action) using the standard Q-learning update rule: 

       Q(s, a) ← Q(s, a) + α * (r + γ * max(Q(s', ·)) - Q(s, a))
      where:
      • α (LEARNING_RATE) is the learning rate
      • γ (DISCOUNT_FACTOR) is the discount factor
      • r is the received reward
      • s' is the next state
      Parameters:
      state - the current game state (s)
      action - the action taken from the current state (a)
      reward - the immediate reward received after taking the action
      nextState - the resulting next game state (s')
